files.doc:
🎛️ The host effects that change the shell view state: active utility, active tool and dialog opening.
 *
 * 🧱️ Child module of {@link ../🟦️.ts | useApplyHostEffects}: each function is one effect arm of the `applyHostEffects` pass, moved verbatim.

📥️ The host effects that bring a document in: archive loading and file open requests.
 *
 * 🧱️ Child module of {@link ../🟦️.ts | useApplyHostEffects}: each function is one effect arm of the `applyHostEffects` pass, moved verbatim.

📤️ The host effects that hand a document out: media downloads, video render and icon render exports.
 *
 * 🧱️ Child module of {@link ../🟦️.ts | useApplyHostEffects}: each function is one effect arm of the `applyHostEffects` pass, moved verbatim.

🔁️ The host effects that continue program work: re-dispatch, media frame requests and extension invocation.
 *
 * 🧱️ Child module of {@link ../🟦️.ts | useApplyHostEffects}: each function is one effect arm of the `applyHostEffects` pass, moved verbatim.

🎯️ The `replayShellCommand` host effect: directory administration, space artifact creation and shell command replay.
 *
 * 🧱️ Child module of {@link ../🟦️.ts | useApplyHostEffects}: the effect arm of the `applyHostEffects` pass, moved verbatim.

🌱️ The host effects that create program instances: spawning and opening plugin instances.
 *
 * 🧱️ Child module of {@link ../🟦️.ts | useApplyHostEffects}: each function is one effect arm of the `applyHostEffects` pass, moved verbatim.

📡️ The operation completion, diagnostic and progress subscriptions of the host effects hook.
 *
 * 🧱️ Child hook module of {@link ../🟦️.ts | useApplyHostEffects}: runs the original `useEffect` statements in order.

items.name: applySetActiveUtilityEffect
items.doc: Mirrors a program's utility switch into the host registers and the follow-up view state.

items.name: applySetActiveToolEffect
items.doc: Mirrors a program's tool switch into the host registers and the follow-up view state.

items.name: applyOpenDialogEffect
items.doc: Opens an owned dialog when the effect's session is still the shown one.

items.name: applyLoadDocumentEffect
items.doc: Loads a pack and spr pair through the program's stepped archive loader with progress and cancellation.

items.name: applyRequestFileOpenEffect
items.doc: Reads the files the user picks and imports them through the program's import action.

items.name: applyDownloadMediaExportEffect
items.doc: Delivers an inline or segmented media export as a download.

items.name: applyVideoRenderExportEffect
items.doc: Runs a video render export and announces its outcome.

items.name: applyIconRenderExportEffect
items.doc: Renders each requested icon and downloads the data URL.

items.name: applyDispatchActionEffect
items.doc: Schedules the program's self re-dispatch through the host continuation scheduler.

items.name: applyRequestMediaFramesEffect
items.doc: Answers a media frame request through the program's media transport.

items.name: applyInvokeExtensionEffect
items.doc: Invokes an extension capability and feeds its completion back through the effect pass.

items.name: applyReplayShellCommandEffect
items.doc: Replays a shell-owned command against the directory, the space index and the artifact creation lane.

items.name: applySpawnPluginInstanceEffect
items.doc: Spawns a plugin instance for the effect's program.

items.name: applyOpenPluginInstanceEffect
items.doc: Opens a plugin instance and mounts it into the shell.

items.name: useOperationCompletionSubscriptions
items.doc: Applies terminal operation publications and shows the operation diagnostics for the active and spawned receivers.

items.name: useOperationProgressSubscriptions
items.doc: Renders a running operation's process through the ui-refresh lane for the session and every spawned program.

types.applyHostEffects: (effects: readonly Effect[], baseSession: ActiveSession, uiScope: UiDirtyScope | undefined, effectOwner: ReturnType<ShellCoreAfterSpawnedSession["captureEffectOwner"]>) => Promise<void>
